scope: Six requested core Bay Area outlet centers; source checks completed with official center websites.
editorialPolicy: description uses verified format/location facts; bestFor and plan are editorial recommendations, not official visiting-duration guidance.
All plan durations exclude travel and do not guarantee completion or queue lengths.
No fixed discounts, opening hours, unverified store counts, free-parking claims or guaranteed driving times are published.
North Bay includes Napa, Petaluma and Vacaville for the site's five-region navigation; this is an editorial grouping, not a transit fare zone.
